verdict.rationale: Reliability analytics are a fair question for an incident management and on-call platform like Rootly, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no analytics dashboards, MTTA/MTTR trends, incident-load reporting or on-call health metrics. A community remark that 'metrics looked worse' is too vague to credit, and the API/MCP incident querying is only a building block a developer could use to construct such analytics.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving
